checklists.subject: Making an employment tribunal claim
checklists.elsewhere: There’s a different way to make a claim to an employment tribunal in Northern Ireland.

groups.heading: To make the claim
groups.lead: To use this service, you’ll need:
items: the names and addresses of all the people making the claim (the ‘claimants’)
the names and addresses of the employer or organisation you’re claiming against (the ‘respondents’)
your Acas early conciliation certificate number

groups.heading: Documents to share
groups.lead: Examples of relevant documents could include:
items: notes from relevant meetings you attended at work

groups.heading: At the hearing
items: You must have all the documents you’re using to support your case with you.

checklists.here: For the time limit, the time-limit tool on this page works out the date from a dated rule, or says that a limit may still apply and where to ask today.

checklists.subject: Making a court claim for money

groups.heading: To claim online
items: You’ll be asked for the name, address and email address of the person you’re claiming against.

groups.heading: To pay the court fee
items: a debit or credit card to pay the court fee
your ‘help with fees’ reference number if you’ve already applied for help with fees online

checklists.basis: Each list is in the words of the page it names, with the part of the page each item is in and the day the page was read, and is said as not recently checked ninety days on. A list says nothing about whether a claim will succeed, what it is worth, or whether a time limit has passed. Nothing here is legal advice.
